verdict.rationale: Built-in panes and tabs are a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. Alacritty's own README explicitly says it lacks tabs and splits, leaving them to a window manager or terminal multiplexer. Its multi-window support only opens separate OS windows, not panes or tabs. Community users confirm they rely on tmux, or switched to WezTerm, because Alacritty has no tabs.
